deptIntro: The department of Sports and Youth Welfare is committed to provide the players of Madhya Pradesh, both from rural and urban areas, with comprehensive facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure, in an effort to overall enhance their performance and prospects. The government of Madhya Pradesh is making every possible effort for the evolution of sports in M. P. with an ambition to bring more laurels to the state.

kheloIndia: The Khelo India program was started by the Government of India in 2016-17 in the place of Rajiv Gandhi Khel Abhiyaan. Competitions of sub-junior level, Junior level and Senior Level are organised under the Khelo India program. Abolishing the Urban Infrastructure Program the Government of India has started the sports infrastructure development program under Khelo India. Under this financial aid is being provided for the several works.
sportsScience: The Sports Science Centre, TT Nagar Stadium, Directorate of Sports and Youth Welfare (DSYW), caters to all the Elite Sports Academies run by the Sports and Youth Welfare Department, Government of M.P. The Sports Medicine Centre was established in 2006-2007.

academy.title: MP State Women's Cricket Academy of Excellence — Shivpuri
academy.body: The MP State Women's Cricket Academy of Excellence in Shivpuri, established in January 2022, serves as a nurturing ground for talented women cricketers. With a focus on providing international-level coaching facilities, the academy boasts modern infrastructure and up-to-date training methodologies. Athletes benefit from the presence of a dedicated cricket stadium, ensuring they have access to top-tier playing conditions. Additionally, the academy offers a fitness center and changing rooms to support the physical preparation of the players. Accommodations provided in the hostel, along with dining facilities, cater to the needs of the athletes, fostering a conducive environment for growth and development. With an administrative office overseeing operations, the academy ensures efficient management of its activities, further enhancing the overall experience for the athletes.
